name: Shrikhand
steps: Line a sieve with clean muslin, set over a bowl and add curd. Cover and drain in the refrigerator for 6–8 hours until thick; discard or separately save the whey.
Warm the milk slightly and steep saffron in it for 10 minutes.
Transfer drained curd to a bowl and whisk until smooth without adding water.
Fold in powdered sugar, cardamom and saffron milk. Taste and adjust sweetness if needed.
Chill for at least 1 hour so the flavours blend and the dessert firms up.
Divide into four bowls and scatter chopped pistachios on top.
tips: Allow 6–8 hours for draining and at least 1 hour chilling, in addition to preparation.
passiveTime: Allow additional soaking, resting, chilling or fermentation as specified in the steps.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
